title: Erdős Problem #1138: Primes in Short Intervals and Maximal Gaps
description: For x/2 < y < x and C > 1, if d is the maximal prime gap below x, is π(y + Cd) - π(y) ~ Cd / log y?

overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1138 asks about the prime counting function in short intervals near maximal gaps. The problem connects two fundamental aspects of prime distribution: the size of maximal gaps between consecutive primes, and the accuracy of asymptotic estimates for π(x) in short intervals.

The conjectured maximal gap d ~ (log x)² (Cramér's conjecture) is far below the threshold h > x^{7/12} needed for unconditional short interval prime number theorem, or even h > x^{1/2+ε} under the Riemann Hypothesis. This makes the problem particularly deep.

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1138.
